<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  PREVIEW MOCK: Sales Dashboard — "Workspace" restyle proposal
  PATH:   Dashboards/Temp/SalesDash_Workspace_Preview.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A standalone, browser-openable dummy of Sales_Dashboard_DragDrop.htm restyled
  to the Workspace design system from Manufacturing/Production_Scheduling_v1.2.htm
  (DS tokens #137FFD, .topbar, .ps-btn, .filterbar/.fdrop, .spill, .tbl-wrap).

  OPEN THIS FILE DIRECTLY IN A BROWSER (needs internet for the CDNs).
  It uses HARDCODED MOCK DATA — no Fishbowl, no fb-lib directives, no SQL.
  Persistence / admin / FBLib.Settings / debug drawer are Stage-B plumbing and
  deliberately stubbed (buttons toast what they would do).

  Demonstrates: topbar chrome + KPI badge strip (drag to reorder, hover to
  remove, + to add) · filter strip with fdrop dropdowns (date range incl.
  custom, 4 dimension filters — selections visibly reshape the mock data) ·
  GridStack drag/resize/lock with 8 representative widgets restyled to the DS
  card look · bar/line toggle · clickable Top Customers → drilldown modal with
  the .tbl-wrap table · widget picker with category tabs.

  Mirrors the workflow where Manufacturing/Temp/ProdSched_vA.htm previewed the
  design that became Production_Scheduling_v1.2.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sales Dashboard — Workspace Preview</title>

  <!-- Same CDN stack as the real dashboard -->
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@10.3.1/dist/gridstack.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@10.3.1/dist/gridstack-all.js"></script>
  <script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       WORKSPACE DESIGN SYSTEM — tokens copied from
       Production_Scheduling_v1.2.htm. In the real (Stage B) file
       these sit AFTER the fb-styles directive include; here they
       stand alone so the mock opens in any browser.
       ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    :root {
      --fb-blue:#137FFD; --fb-blue-accent:#0265D9; --fb-blue-hover:#4499FD; --fb-blue-pressed:#024EA7;
      --fb-negative:#DF0C0C; --fb-neutral:#547089; --fb-success:#188B3F; --fb-warning:#C28028;
      --bg-primary:#FFFFFF; --bg-1:#F9FAFB; --bg-2:#ECF0F4; --bg-3:#E2E8EE; --bg-4:#C1CFDC;
      --menu-bg:#2D3B49; --menu-bg-2:#283640;
      --c-primary:#192229; --c-secondary:#547089; --c-tertiary:#AABBCB; --link:#0265D9;
      --acc-magenta:#E44ECB; --acc-magenta-bg:#FAD6F4; --acc-magenta-con:#6F115F;
      --acc-yellow:#F8C912; --acc-yellow-bg:#FCF38E; --acc-yellow-con:#8F7704;
      --acc-teal:#39B884; --acc-teal-bg:#C5F2EF; --acc-teal-con:#176A4F;
      --font:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
      --mono:'Space Mono',ui-monospace,'Consolas',monospace;
      --r-btn:3px; --r-card:6px; --r-modal:8px; --r-pill:999px;
      --sh1:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06); --sh2:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08); --sh3:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      --border:#E2E8EE; --border-strong:#C1CFDC;
      --color-primary:#137FFD; --color-primary-dark:#0265D9;
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height:100%; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; font-family:var(--font); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--c-primary); }
    .mono { font-family:var(--mono); }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width:8px; height:8px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--bg-4); border-radius:4px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background:var(--fb-neutral); }

    /* ── App shell — flex column so the grid fills to the viewport bottom ── */
    .app-col { display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100vh; }
    #main-content { flex:1; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; padding:16px 22px; }

    /* ── Topbar (v1.2 .topbar family) ── */
    .topbar { background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:0 22px; flex-shrink:0; }
    .topbar-row1 { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height:60px; gap:12px; }
    .title-wrap { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; min-width:0; }
    .title-wrap h1 { font-size:19px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.01em; margin:0; line-height:1.1; color:var(--c-primary); white-space:nowrap; }
    .crumb { font-size:11px; color:var(--c-tertiary); font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
    .subline { font-size:11.5px; color:var(--c-secondary); white-space:nowrap; }
    .top-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0; flex-wrap:nowrap; }

    /* ── ps-btn family (v1.2) ── */
    .ps-btn { height:36px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:var(--r-btn); border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
      background:#fff; color:var(--c-secondary); font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
      display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; transition:.15s; white-space:nowrap;
      cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
    .ps-btn:hover { background:var(--bg-1); border-color:var(--fb-neutral); }
    .ps-btn svg { width:16px; height:16px; }
    .ps-btn.primary { background:var(--fb-blue); border-color:var(--fb-blue-accent); color:#fff; }
    .ps-btn.primary:hover { background:var(--fb-blue-accent); }
    .ps-btn.icon { width:36px; padding:0; justify-content:center; }
    .ps-btn.sm { height:28px; padding:0 10px; font-size:12px; }
    .ps-btn.sm svg { width:14px; height:14px; }
    .ps-btn.sm.ok { background:#D1FAE5; border-color:#6EE7B7; color:#065F46; }
    .ps-btn.sm.ro { background:#FEE2E2; border-color:#FCA5A5; color:#991B1B; }
    .ps-btn.on { background:#E3F0FF; border-color:#BFDBFE; color:var(--fb-blue); }

    /* ── Consolidated status pill (.spill, v1.2) ── */
    .spill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:4px 10px;
      border-radius:var(--r-pill); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3;
      border:1px solid; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0; }
    .spill.neutral  { background:#F1F5F9; border-color:#CBD5E1; color:#475569; }
    .spill.active   { background:#EFF6FF; border-color:#BFDBFE; color:#1E40AF; }
    .spill.success  { background:#D1FAE5; border-color:#6EE7B7; color:#065F46; }
    .spill.caution  { background:#FEF3C7; border-color:#FCD34D; color:#92400E; }
    .spill.critical { background:#FEE2E2; border-color:#FCA5A5; color:#991B1B; }

    /* ── KPI badge strip (topbar row 2) ── */
    .kpi-strip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:0 0 9px; overflow-x:auto; }
    .kpi-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:0 10px;
      background:var(--bg-1); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-card);
      font-size:12px; cursor:grab; user-select:none; position:relative; flex-shrink:0; transition:.12s; }
    .kpi-badge:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong); box-shadow:var(--sh1); }
    .kpi-badge.dragging { opacity:.4; }
    .kpi-badge svg { width:13px; height:13px; flex-shrink:0; }
    .kpi-badge .bl { font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--c-secondary); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; }
    .kpi-badge .bv { font-weight:800; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
    .kpi-badge .bx { display:none; position:absolute; top:-6px; right:-6px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--fb-negative); color:#fff; border:none; font-size:10px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer;
      align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0; }
    .kpi-badge:hover .bx { display:flex; }
    .badge-add { width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:var(--r-card); border:1px dashed var(--border-strong);
      background:transparent; color:var(--c-tertiary); font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0;
      display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:.12s; }
    .badge-add:hover { border-color:var(--fb-blue); color:var(--fb-blue); }
    .badge-pop { position:absolute; z-index:300; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
      border-radius:var(--r-card); box-shadow:var(--sh2); padding:6px; min-width:170px; display:none; }
    .badge-pop.open { display:block; }
    .badge-pop .bp-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px;
      font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; }
    .badge-pop .bp-item:hover { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .badge-pop .bp-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }

    /* ── Filter strip (v1.2 .filterbar + .fdrop) ── */
    .filterbar { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:8px 22px; background:#fff;
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); flex-wrap:wrap; min-height:44px; flex-shrink:0; }
    .fchip { height:26px; padding:0 9px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
      background:#fff; color:var(--c-secondary); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600;
      display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; transition:.15s; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
    .fchip:hover { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .fchip svg { width:13px; height:13px; color:var(--c-tertiary); }
    .fchip.on { background:#E3F0FF; border-color:#BFDBFE; color:var(--fb-blue); }
    .fchip.on svg { color:var(--fb-blue); }
    .filter-sep { width:1px; height:18px; background:var(--border-strong); margin:0 9px; }
    .filterbar .spring { flex:1; }
    .fdrop { position:relative; display:inline-flex; }
    .fdrop-caret { transition:transform .15s; }
    .fdrop-btn.open .fdrop-caret { transform:rotate(180deg); }
    .fdrop-panel { position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 6px); left:0; z-index:260; display:none;
      min-width:200px; max-width:280px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
      border-radius:var(--r-card); box-shadow:var(--sh2); padding:6px; }
    .fdrop-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;
      padding:4px 8px 6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--c-tertiary); }
    .fdrop-head a { color:var(--fb-negative); cursor:pointer; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:normal; font-weight:600; }
    .fdrop-head a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
    .fdrop-list { max-height:260px; overflow-y:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; }
    .fdrop-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 8px; border-radius:4px;
      font-size:12px; color:var(--c-primary); cursor:pointer; }
    .fdrop-item:hover { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .fdrop-item.sel { background:#E3F0FF; }
    .fdrop-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); }
    .fdrop-name { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

    /* ── Drop-down drawers (stand-in for fb-styles .fb-drawer chrome) ── */
    .pv-drawer { display:none; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:var(--sh1); flex-shrink:0; }
    .pv-drawer.open { display:block; }
    .pv-drawer-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:12px 22px 0; }
    .pv-drawer-head h2 { font-size:15px; font-weight:800; margin:0; color:var(--c-primary); }
    .pv-drawer-body { padding:10px 22px 14px; font-size:13px; color:var(--c-primary); }
    .pv-drawer-close { border:none; background:transparent; font-size:20px; color:var(--c-secondary); cursor:pointer; line-height:1; }
    .ds-toggle-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:6px 10px; background:var(--bg-1);
      border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-card); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; max-width:420px; }
    .ds-toggle-row input { accent-color:var(--fb-blue); }

    /* ── Widget cards (DS panel look — 6px radius, DS borders/shadows) ── */
    .grid-stack { background:transparent; }
    .grid-stack-item-content { border-radius:var(--r-card); overflow:hidden; }
    .grid-stack-placeholder > .placeholder-content { background:rgba(19,127,253,.08); border:2px dashed var(--fb-blue); border-radius:var(--r-card); }
    .widget-wrapper { width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#fff;
      border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-card); overflow:hidden; box-shadow:var(--sh1); transition:box-shadow .2s; }
    .widget-wrapper:hover { box-shadow:var(--sh2); }
    .widget-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
      flex-shrink:0; background:#fff; cursor:grab; user-select:none; }
    .widget-header:active { cursor:grabbing; }
    .widget-drag-handle { color:var(--bg-4); display:flex; align-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:color .15s; }
    .widget-header:hover .widget-drag-handle { color:var(--c-tertiary); }
    .widget-icon { width:16px; height:16px; color:var(--fb-blue); flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
    .widget-icon svg { width:100%; height:100%; }
    .widget-title { font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--c-primary); flex:1; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
    /* CRITICAL: padding:0 so clientHeight = exact usable area for D3 */
    .widget-body { flex:1; overflow:hidden; padding:0; position:relative; min-height:0; }
    .widget-remove { border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--c-tertiary); cursor:pointer; padding:2px; border-radius:4px; display:flex; }
    .widget-remove:hover { color:var(--fb-negative); background:#FDE7E7; }
    .chart-toggle-btn { border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff; color:var(--c-tertiary); border-radius:4px;
      padding:3px 5px; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; }
    .chart-toggle-btn.active { background:#E3F0FF; border-color:#BFDBFE; color:var(--fb-blue); }
    .info-icon-btn { border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--c-tertiary); cursor:help; padding:2px; display:flex; width:18px; height:18px; }
    .info-icon-btn svg { width:100%; height:100%; }

    /* ── KPI tile ── */
    .kpi-root { height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center; padding:8px 18px; position:relative; }
    .kpi-icon-lg { width:22px; height:22px; margin-bottom:6px; opacity:.9; }
    .kpi-icon-lg svg { width:100%; height:100%; }
    .kpi-value { font-size:26px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.1; display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
    .kpi-delta-inline { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; }
    .kpi-label-narrow { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--c-secondary); margin-top:4px; }
    .kpi-accent { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:4px; }

    /* ── In-widget data table (light DS treatment) ── */
    .data-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12px; }
    .data-table th { position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--bg-1); color:var(--c-secondary); text-align:left;
      font-size:10px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:7px 12px;
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); white-space:nowrap; z-index:1; }
    .data-table td { padding:6px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2); white-space:nowrap; }
    .data-table tr:hover td { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .data-table td.num, .data-table th.num { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
    .tbl-scroll { height:100%; overflow:auto; }

    /* ── Drilldown table (full v1.2 .tbl-wrap treatment — dark thead) ── */
    .tbl-wrap { background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-card); overflow:auto; box-shadow:var(--sh1); max-height:420px; }
    .tbl-wrap table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px; }
    .tbl-wrap thead th { background:var(--menu-bg); color:#DCE6F1; text-align:left; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;
      text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; padding:11px 14px; white-space:nowrap; position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; }
    .tbl-wrap tbody td { padding:9px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2); white-space:nowrap; }
    .tbl-wrap tbody tr { cursor:pointer; transition:.1s; }
    .tbl-wrap tbody tr:hover { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .tbl-wrap td .wo { font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:700; color:var(--link); }
    .tbl-wrap td.num, .tbl-wrap th.num { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

    /* ── D3 chart chrome ── */
    .grid-line { stroke:var(--bg-2); stroke-width:1; }
    .axis text { fill:var(--c-secondary); font-size:9.5px; }
    .axis path, .axis line { stroke:var(--bg-3); }
    .tile-skel { height:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--c-tertiary); font-size:12px; }

    /* ── Chart tooltip ── */
    #ttip { position:fixed; z-index:1000; background:rgba(25,34,41,.95); color:#fff; padding:8px 11px;
      border-radius:6px; font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.5; pointer-events:none; display:none; box-shadow:var(--sh3); max-width:260px; }

    /* ── Modals (DS: --r-modal, blur overlay) ── */
    .modal-overlay { position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,.5); backdrop-filter:blur(4px); z-index:400;
      display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px; }
    .modal-overlay.show { display:flex; }
    .modal-box { background:#fff; border-radius:var(--r-modal); box-shadow:var(--sh3); max-width:860px; width:100%;
      max-height:86vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; }
    .modal-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
    .modal-head h2 { font-size:16px; font-weight:800; margin:0; }
    .modal-head .sub { font-size:12px; color:var(--c-secondary); margin-top:2px; }
    .modal-body { padding:16px 20px; overflow-y:auto; }
    .close-x { width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:var(--r-btn); border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff;
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--c-secondary); cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; }
    .close-x:hover { background:var(--bg-1); }
    .close-x svg { width:18px; height:18px; }
    .tab-btn { height:30px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
      background:#fff; color:var(--c-secondary); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
    .tab-btn.active { background:var(--fb-blue); border-color:var(--fb-blue-accent); color:#fff; }
    .widget-card { border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-card); padding:12px; cursor:pointer;
      transition:.12s; background:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; }
    .widget-card:hover { border-color:var(--fb-blue); box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(19,127,253,.12); }
    .widget-card .wc-t { font-size:13px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
    .widget-card .wc-t svg { width:15px; height:15px; }
    .widget-card .wc-d { font-size:11.5px; color:var(--c-secondary); line-height:1.4; }

    /* ── Toasts (v1.2 look) ── */
    .toast-container { position:fixed; bottom:1rem; right:1rem; z-index:9999; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.5rem; }
    .toast { min-width:280px; padding:12px 16px; background:#fff; border-radius:var(--r-modal); box-shadow:var(--sh2);
      border-left:4px solid var(--fb-blue); animation:slideIn .3s ease-out; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--c-primary);
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
    .toast.success { border-color:var(--fb-success); }
    .toast.error { border-color:var(--fb-negative); }
    @keyframes slideIn { from { transform:translateX(400px); opacity:0; } to { transform:translateX(0); opacity:1; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app-col">

  <!-- ═══ TOPBAR ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-row1">
      <div class="title-wrap">
        <span class="crumb">Sales · Analytics <span class="spill caution" title="Standalone preview with mock data — not connected to Fishbowl">Preview · mock data</span></span>
        <h1>Sales Dashboard</h1>
        <span class="subline" id="dateRangeDisplay">Loading…</span>
      </div>
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" onclick="refreshDashboard()" title="Refresh data">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 4v6h6M20 20v-6h-6M20 8a8 8 0 00-14.9-2M4 16a8 8 0 0014.9 2"/></svg>
        </button>
        <button class="ps-btn icon" type="button" id="lockBtn" onclick="toggleLock()" title="Lock / unlock layout editing">

// Deterministic "filter effect" so dimension picks visibly reshape mock data.
function fxHash(){
  const s = F.customerGroup + F.productCategory + F.salesperson + F.margin;
  if (s === '%%%%') return 0;
  let h=0; for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++) h=(h*31+s.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;
  return h;
}
function fxFactor(){ const h=fxHash(); return h===0 ? 1 : 0.35 + (h%56)/100; }
function fxOffset(){ const h=fxHash(); return h===0 ? 0 : h%3; }

function sdToggleDropdown(which){ _openDrop = (_openDrop===which)?null:which; renderFilterbar(); }
function sdSetDateRange(key){
  F.datePreset = key;
  if (key==='custom'){
    if (!F.customStart) F.customStart = moment().subtract(3,'months').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
    if (!F.customEnd)   F.customEnd   = moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD');
    _openDrop = 'date';
  } else { _openDrop = null; }
  onFilterChange();
}
function sdSetCustom(which,val){
  if (which==='start') F.customStart = val; else F.customEnd = val;
  F.datePreset = 'custom'; _openDrop = 'date';
  onFilterChange();
}
function sdSetDim(which,val){ F[which] = val; _openDrop = null; onFilterChange(); }
function clearAllFilters(){ F.customerGroup='%'; F.productCategory='%'; F.salesperson='%'; F.margin='%'; onFilterChange(); }

// ── Chart tooltip ──
function showTip(ev, html){ const t=document.getElementById('ttip'); t.innerHTML=html; t.style.display='block'; moveTip(ev); }
function moveTip(ev){ const t=document.getElementById('ttip');
  const x = ev.clientX+14, y = ev.clientY+14;
  t.style.left = (x+260>window.innerWidth ? ev.clientX-274 : x)+'px';
  t.style.top  = (y+120>window.innerHeight ? ev.clientY-130 : y)+'px'; }
function hideTip(){ document.getElementById('ttip').style.display='none'; }

function renderKPI(el, kind, cfg={}){
  const k = dKpis();
  let val, color, label, icon;
  if (kind==='revenue'){ val=fmt$(k.total_revenue,true); color=DS.blue; label='Revenue'; icon=KPI_ICONS.revenue; }
  else { val=fmtPct(k.avg_margin); color = k.avg_margin>=0.3?DS.success:k.avg_margin>=0.15?DS.warning:DS.negative; label='GP %'; icon=KPI_ICONS.avgmargin; }
  let delta='';
  if (cfg.withPriorDelta){
    const p = dKpisPrior();
    const cur = kind==='revenue' ? k.total_revenue : k.avg_margin;
    const pri = kind==='revenue' ? p.total_revenue : p.avg_margin;
    const pct = ((cur-pri)/Math.abs(pri))*100, up = pct>=0;
    delta = '<span class="kpi-delta-inline" style="color:'+(up?DS.success:DS.negative)+'">'+(up?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(pct).toFixed(1)+'%</span>';
  }
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="kpi-root">'+
    '<div class="kpi-icon-lg" style="color:'+color+'"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+icon+'</svg></div>'+
    '<div class="kpi-value" style="color:'+color+'"><span>'+val+'</span>'+delta+'</div>'+
    '<div class="kpi-accent" style="background:'+color+'"></div>'+
    '<div class="kpi-label-narrow">'+label+'</div></div>';
}

function renderTimeSeries(el, cfg){
  const data = dMonths();
  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;
  const mode = (cfg && cfg.chartType) || 'bar';
  const m = { top:12, right:56, bottom:42, left:64 };
  const iw = W-m.left-m.right, ih = H-m.top-m.bottom;
  if (iw < 20 || ih < 20) return;
  const svg = d3.select(el).append('svg').attr('width',W).attr('height',H).append('g').attr('transform','translate('+m.left+','+m.top+')');
  const xBand = d3.scaleBand().domain(data.map(d=>d.month)).range([0,iw]).padding(0.25);
  const yRev  = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, d3.max(data,d=>d.revenue)*1.18]).nice().range([ih,0]);
  const yMarg = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,0.65]).range([ih,0]);
  svg.append('g').selectAll('line').data(yRev.ticks(5)).join('line').attr('class','grid-line').attr('x1',0).attr('x2',iw).attr('y1',d=>yRev(d)).attr('y2',d=>yRev(d));
  if (mode==='bar'){
    svg.selectAll('.rev-bar').data(data).join('rect')
      .attr('x',d=>xBand(d.month)).attr('y',d=>yRev(d.revenue))
      .attr('width',xBand.bandwidth()).attr('height',d=>Math.max(0,ih-yRev(d.revenue)))
      .attr('fill',DS.blue).attr('rx',3).attr('opacity',0.88)
      .on('mouseover',(ev,d)=>showTip(ev,'<strong>'+moment(d.month).format('MMM YYYY')+'</strong><br>Revenue: '+fmt$(d.revenue)+'<br>COGS: '+fmt$(d.cogs)+'<br>Margin: '+fmtPct(d.avg_margin)))
      .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout',hideTip);
  } else {
    const line = d3.line().x(d=>xBand(d.month)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).y(d=>yRev(d.revenue)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);
    svg.append('path').datum(data).attr('fill','none').attr('stroke',DS.blue).attr('stroke-width',2.5).attr('d',line);
    svg.append('path').datum(data).attr('fill',DS.blue).attr('opacity',0.08)
      .attr('d', d3.area().x(d=>xBand(d.month)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).y0(ih).y1(d=>yRev(d.revenue)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX));
    svg.selectAll('.rv-dot').data(data).join('circle')
      .attr('cx',d=>xBand(d.month)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).attr('cy',d=>yRev(d.revenue))
      .attr('r',4).attr('fill','#fff').attr('stroke',DS.blue).attr('stroke-width',2)
      .on('mouseover',(ev,d)=>showTip(ev,'<strong>'+moment(d.month).format('MMM YYYY')+'</strong><br>Revenue: '+fmt$(d.revenue)+'<br>Margin: '+fmtPct(d.avg_margin)))
      .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout',hideTip);
  }
  const margLine = d3.line().x(d=>xBand(d.month)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).y(d=>yMarg(d.avg_margin)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);
  svg.append('path').datum(data).attr('fill','none').attr('stroke',DS.warning).attr('stroke-width',2).attr('stroke-dasharray','5,4').attr('d',margLine);
  svg.selectAll('.mg-dot').data(data).join('circle')
    .attr('cx',d=>xBand(d.month)+xBand.bandwidth()/2).attr('cy',d=>yMarg(d.avg_margin))
    .attr('r',3).attr('fill','#fff').attr('stroke',DS.warning).attr('stroke-width',1.5);
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').attr('transform','translate(0,'+ih+')')
    .call(d3.axisBottom(xBand).tickFormat(d=>moment(d).format('MMM YY'))).selectAll('text').attr('transform','rotate(-40)').style('text-anchor','end');
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').call(d3.axisLeft(yRev).ticks(5).tickFormat(d=>'$'+d3.format('.2s')(d)));
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').attr('transform','translate('+iw+',0)').call(d3.axisRight(yMarg).ticks(4).tickFormat(d=>(d*100).toFixed(0)+'%'));
  const lgx = iw-120;
  [{c:DS.blue,lbl:'Revenue',dash:false},{c:DS.warning,lbl:'Margin %',dash:true}].forEach((l,i)=>{
    const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform','translate('+(lgx+i*64)+',-2)');
    if (l.dash) g.append('line').attr('x1',0).attr('x2',14).attr('y1',5).attr('y2',5).attr('stroke',l.c).attr('stroke-width',2).attr('stroke-dasharray','4,3');
    else g.append('rect').attr('width',12).attr('height',7).attr('rx',2).attr('fill',l.c).attr('y',2);
    g.append('text').attr('x',18).attr('y',9).style('fill','var(--c-secondary)').style('font-size','9px').text(l.lbl);
  });
}

function renderHorizBar(el, rows, opts={}){
  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;
  const data = rows.map(d=>({ name:d.name, value:d.revenue, meta:d }));
  const m = { top:6, right:84, bottom:18, left:Math.min(130, W*0.32) };
  const iw = W-m.left-m.right, ih = H-m.top-m.bottom;
  if (iw < 20 || ih < 20) return;
  const svg = d3.select(el).append('svg').attr('width',W).attr('height',H).append('g').attr('transform','translate('+m.left+','+m.top+')');
  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, d3.max(data,d=>d.value)||1]).nice().range([0,iw]);
  const y = d3.scaleBand().domain(data.map(d=>d.name)).range([0,ih]).padding(0.22);
  svg.append('g').selectAll('line').data(x.ticks(4)).join('line').attr('class','grid-line').attr('x1',d=>x(d)).attr('x2',d=>x(d)).attr('y1',0).attr('y2',ih);
  svg.selectAll('.bar').data(data).join('rect')
    .attr('x',0).attr('y',d=>y(d.name)).attr('width',d=>Math.max(1,x(d.value))).attr('height',y.bandwidth()).attr('rx',3)
    .attr('fill',(d,i)=>{
      if (opts.colorMode==='margin'){ const mg=d.meta.avg_margin; return mg>=0.30?DS.success:mg>=0.15?DS.warning:DS.negative; }
      return COLOR_PALETTE[i % COLOR_PALETTE.length];
    })
    .style('cursor', opts.clickable ? 'pointer' : 'default')
    .on('mouseover',(ev,d)=>showTip(ev,'<strong>'+d.name+'</strong><br>'+fmt$(d.value)+
      (d.meta.orders!=null?'<br>Orders: '+fmtNum(d.meta.orders):'')+
      (d.meta.avg_margin!=null?'<br>Margin: '+fmtPct(d.meta.avg_margin):'')+
      (opts.clickable?'<br><em>Click for order drilldown</em>':'')))
    .on('mousemove',moveTip).on('mouseout',hideTip)
    .on('click', opts.clickable ? ((ev,d)=>opts.clickable(d.meta)) : null);
  svg.selectAll('.val-lbl').data(data).join('text')
    .attr('x',d=>x(d.value)+4).attr('y',d=>y(d.name)+y.bandwidth()/2).attr('dy','0.35em')
    .style('fill','var(--c-tertiary)').style('font-size','9px').text(d=>fmt$(d.value,true));
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').attr('transform','translate(0,'+ih+')').call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(4).tickFormat(d=>'$'+d3.format('.2s')(d)));
  svg.append('g').attr('class','axis').call(d3.axisLeft(y).tickFormat(d=>d.length>15?d.slice(0,14)+'…':d)).selectAll('text').style('font-size','10px');
}

function renderDonut(el, rows, opts={}){
  el.innerHTML = '';
  const W = el.clientWidth, H = el.clientHeight;
  if (W < 80 || H < 50) return;
  const data = rows.map(d=>({ name:d.name, value:d.revenue }));
  const total = d3.sum(data,d=>d.value)||1;
  const csz = Math.min(W*0.48, H-8, 210), r = csz/2;
  const palette = d3.scaleOrdinal().domain(data.map(d=>d.name)).range(COLOR_PALETTE);
  const color = name => (opts.colorMap && opts.colorMap[name]) || palette(name);
  const wrap = d3.select(el).append('div').style('display','flex').style('align-items','center').style('gap','10px').style('height','100%').style('overflow','hidden').style('padding','4px 10px');
  const svg = wrap.append('div').style('flex-shrink','0').append('svg').attr('width',csz).attr('height',csz).append('g').attr('transform','translate('+r+','+r+')');
  const leg = wrap.append('div').style('flex','1').style('overflow-y','auto').style('min-width','0');
  const arc = d3.arc().innerRadius(r*.44).outerRadius(r*.84);
  const arcHov = d3.arc().innerRadius(r*.44).outerRadius(r*.92);
  const pie = d3.pie().value(d=>d.value).sort(null);
  svg.selectAll('path').data(pie(data)).join('path').attr('d',arc)
    .attr('fill',d=>color(d.data.name)).attr('stroke','#fff').attr('stroke-width',2)
    .on('mouseover', function(ev,d){ d3.select(this).transition().duration(100).attr('d',arcHov);
      showTip(ev,'<strong>'+d.data.name+'</strong><br>'+fmt$(d.data.value)+'<br>'+(d.data.value/total*100).toFixed(1)+'% of total'); })
    .on('mousemove',moveTip)
    .on('mouseout', function(){ d3.select(this).transition().duration(100).attr('d',arc); hideTip(); });
  data.forEach(d=>{
    leg.append('div').style('display','flex').style('align-items','center').style('gap','7px').style('font-size','11px').style('padding','2px 0')
      .html('<span style="width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;background:'+color(d.name)+';flex-shrink:0"></span>'+
        '<span style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--c-primary)">'+d.name+'</span>'+
        '<span style="color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:600">'+(d.value/total*100).toFixed(0)+'%</span>');
  });
}

// ── Drilldown (Top Customers bar click → modal with .tbl-wrap table) ──
function openCustomerDrilldown(cust){
  document.getElementById('ddTitle').textContent = cust.name;
  document.getElementById('ddSubtitle').textContent =
    fmt$(cust.revenue)+' revenue · '+fmtNum(cust.orders)+' orders · '+fmtPct(cust.avg_margin)+' avg margin (period)';
  const body = document.getElementById('ddBody');
  const n = 7;
  let html = '';
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const num = 'SO-1'+String(400-i*13).padStart(4,'0');
    const d = moment().subtract(i*11+3,'days');
    const rev = cust.revenue/cust.orders * (2.4 - i*0.18);
    const mg = cust.avg_margin + (i%3-1)*0.045;
    const mc = mg>=0.30?DS.success:mg>=0.15?DS.warning:DS.negative;
    const st = i===0 ? '<span class="spill active">Issued</span>' : i<3 ? '<span class="spill caution">In Progress</span>' : '<span class="spill success">Fulfilled</span>';
    html += '<tr onclick="toast(\'Would open '+num+' in the Sales Order module\')">'+
      '<td><span class="wo">'+num+'</span></td><td>'+d.format('D MMM YY')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="num">'+fmt$(rev)+'</td><td class="num" style="color:'+mc+';font-weight:700">'+fmtPct(mg)+'</td><td>'+st+'</td></tr>';
  }
  body.innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById('drilldownModal').classList.add('show');
}
function closeDrilldown(){ document.getElementById('drilldownModal').classList.remove('show'); }

// ── Widget shell (same markup pattern as the real dashboard) ──
let grid = null;
const widgetStore = new Map();

function buildWidgetContent(type, cfg){
  const reg = WIDGET_REGISTRY[type];
  const activeLine = cfg && cfg.chartType === 'line';
  const toggleHTML = reg.hasChartToggle ? '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;margin-right:2px;">'+
    '<button class="chart-toggle-btn '+(!activeLine?'active':'')+'" data-chart="bar" title="Bar chart"><svg width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="12" width="4" height="9" rx="1"/><rect x="10" y="7" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/><rect x="17" y="3" width="4" height="18" rx="1"/></svg></button>'+
    '<button class="chart-toggle-btn '+(activeLine?'active':'')+'" data-chart="line" title="Line chart"><svg width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="3 17 9 11 13 15 21 7"/></svg></button></div>' : '';
  return '<div class="widget-wrapper">'+
    '<div class="widget-header">'+
      '<div class="widget-drag-handle"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="currentColor">'+
        '<circle cx="4" cy="3.5" r="1.2"/><circle cx="10" cy="3.5" r="1.2"/><circle cx="4" cy="7" r="1.2"/>'+
        '<circle cx="10" cy="7" r="1.2"/><circle cx="4" cy="10.5" r="1.2"/><circle cx="10" cy="10.5" r="1.2"/></svg></div>'+
      '<span class="widget-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+(reg.icon||'')+'</svg></span>'+
      '<span class="widget-title">'+reg.title+'</span>'+
      '<button class="info-icon-btn" data-tooltip="'+(reg.description||'').replace(/"/g,'"')+'"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/></svg></button>'+
      toggleHTML+
      '<button class="widget-remove" title="Remove widget"><svg width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg></button>'+
    '</div><div class="widget-body"></div></div>';
}

function addWidget(type, cfg={}, pos={}){
  const reg = WIDGET_REGISTRY[type];
  if (!reg) return null;
  const opts = { w:pos.w||reg.defaultW, h:pos.h||reg.defaultH, minW:type.startsWith('kpi-')?2:1, minH:2, content:buildWidgetContent(type,cfg) };
  if (pos.x !== undefined) opts.x = pos.x;
  if (pos.y !== undefined) opts.y = pos.y;
  const el = grid.addWidget(opts);
  const bodyEl = el.querySelector('.widget-body');
  const state = { type, config:{...cfg}, bodyEl, reg };
  widgetStore.set(el, state);
  el.dataset.widgetType = type;
  el.querySelector('.widget-remove').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ grid.removeWidget(el); widgetStore.delete(el); });
  const infoBtn = el.querySelector('.info-icon-btn');
  if (infoBtn){
    const desc = infoBtn.getAttribute('data-tooltip')||'';
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ev=>{ if (desc) showTip(ev, desc); });
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mousemove', moveTip);
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip);
    infoBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', ev=>ev.stopPropagation());
  }
  el.querySelectorAll('.chart-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      state.config.chartType = btn.dataset.chart;
      el.querySelectorAll('.chart-toggle-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.chart===state.config.chartType));
      doRender(el);
    });
    btn.addEventListener('mousedown', ev=>ev.stopPropagation());
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>doRender(el)));
  return el;
}

function doRender(el){
  const state = widgetStore.get(el);
  if (!state) return;
  state.bodyEl.innerHTML = '';
  try { state.reg.render(state.bodyEl, state.config); }
  catch(e){ console.error('render error', state.type, e); }
}
function rerenderAll(){ widgetStore.forEach((_,el)=>doRender(el)); }

const DEFAULT_LAYOUT = [
  { type:'kpi-revenue',     x:0, y:0, w:2, h:2 },
  { type:'kpi-margin',      x:2, y:0, w:2, h:2 },
  { type:'monthly-revenue', x:4, y:0, w:8, h:4 },
  { type:'top-customers',   x:0, y:2, w:4, h:4 },
  { type:'category-mix',    x:4, y:4, w:4, h:3 },
  { type:'new-vs-repeat',   x:8, y:4, w:4, h:3 },
  { type:'monthly-table',   x:0, y:6, w:4, h:4 },
  { type:'neg-margin',      x:4, y:7, w:8, h:3 }
];
function loadLayout(layout){
  grid.removeAll(); widgetStore.clear();
  grid.batchUpdate();
  layout.forEach(item=>addWidget(item.type, item.cfg||{}, item));
  grid.batchUpdate(false);
}

// ── Lock / edit controls ──
let isLocked = false;   // preview starts UNLOCKED so drag/resize is instantly visible
function applyLockState(){
  const lockBtn = document.getElementById('lockBtn');
  const lockIcon = document.getElementById('lockIcon');
  const editControls = document.getElementById('editControls');
  if (isLocked){
    grid.setStatic(true);
    editControls.style.display = 'none';
    lockBtn.classList.remove('on');
    lockBtn.title = 'Dashboard locked — click to edit';
    lockIcon.innerHTML = '<rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0110 0v4"/>';
  } else {
    grid.setStatic(false);
    editControls.style.display = 'flex';
    lockBtn.classList.add('on');
    lockBtn.title = 'Editing enabled — click to lock';
    lockIcon.innerHTML = '<rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 019.9-1"/>';
  }
}
function toggleLock(){ isLocked = !isLocked; applyLockState(); }
function resetLayout(){ loadLayout(DEFAULT_LAYOUT); toast('Layout reset to default'); }
function saveLayout(){ toast('Preview stub — the real report saves per-user via FBLib.Settings', 'success'); }
function publishMasterLayout(){ toast('Preview stub — the real report publishes via FBLib.Settings.publishMaster (admin only)', 'success'); }
let _userEditing = true;
function toggleUserEditing(){

  btn.classList.toggle('ok', _userEditing);

'<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/></svg>Users: Can Edit'
    : '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0110 0v4"/></svg>Users: Read Only';
  toast('Preview stub — the real report locks via FBLib.Settings.setLock');
}

// ── Widget picker ──
let _pickerTab = 'all';
function openWidgetPicker(){ renderPicker(); document.getElementById('widgetPickerModal').classList.add('show'); }
function closeWidgetPicker(){ document.getElementById('widgetPickerModal').classList.remove('show'); }
function renderPicker(){
  const tabs = [['all','All'],['kpi','KPIs'],['chart','Charts'],['table','Tables']];
  document.getElementById('pickerTabs').innerHTML = tabs.map(t=>
    '<button type="button" class="tab-btn'+(_pickerTab===t[0]?' active':'')+'" onclick="setPickerTab(\''+t[0]+'\')">'+t[1]+'</button>').join('');
  const catColors = { kpi:DS.warning, chart:DS.blue, table:DS.magenta };
  document.getElementById('pickerGrid').innerHTML = Object.entries(WIDGET_REGISTRY)
    .filter(([,r])=>_pickerTab==='all'||r.category===_pickerTab)
    .map(([type,r])=>'<div class="widget-card" onclick="pickWidget(\''+type+'\')">'+
      '<div class="wc-t"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="'+(catColors[r.category]||DS.blue)+'" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+r.icon+'</svg>'+r.title+'</div>'+
      '<div class="wc-d">'+r.description+'</div>'+
      '<button type="button" class="ps-btn primary sm" style="align-self:flex-start;margin-top:2px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();pickWidget(\''+type+'\')">Add</button></div>').join('');
}
function setPickerTab(t){ _pickerTab = t; renderPicker(); }
function pickWidget(type){ addWidget(type); closeWidgetPicker(); toast(WIDGET_REGISTRY[type].title+' added'); }
document.getElementById('widgetPickerModal').addEventListener('click', e=>{ if (e.target.id==='widgetPickerModal') closeWidgetPicker(); });
document.getElementById('drilldownModal').addEventListener('click', e=>{ if (e.target.id==='drilldownModal') closeDrilldown(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if (e.key==='Escape'){ closeWidgetPicker(); closeDrilldown(); } });

// ── Drawers (preview stand-ins for fb-drawers) ──
function toggleDrawer(id){
  ['settingsDrawer','helpDrawer'].forEach(d=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(d);
    if (d===id) el.classList.toggle('open'); else el.classList.remove('open');
  });
}

// ── Toasts ──
function toast(msg, type='info'){
  const c = document.getElementById('toasts');
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'toast '+type;
  t.innerHTML = '<span>'+(type==='success'?'✓':type==='error'?'✕':'ℹ')+'</span><span>'+msg+'</span>';
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; t.style.transition='opacity .3s'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),320); }, 2800);
}

// ── Resize re-render (debounced) ──
let _rsTimer = null;
window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{ clearTimeout(_rsTimer); _rsTimer = setTimeout(rerenderAll, 180); });

// ── Init ──
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ()=>{
  grid = GridStack.init({
    column: 12, cellHeight: 80, margin: 10,
    resizable: { handles:'all' },
    draggable: { handle:'.widget-header' },
    animate: true
  }, '#myGrid');
  grid.on('resizestop', (ev,el)=>{ setTimeout(()=>doRender(el), 60); });

  renderFilterbar();
  updateDateDisplay();
  renderBadges();
  loadLayout(DEFAULT_LAYOUT);
  applyLockState();
  toast('Workspace preview loaded — drag a widget header, try the filters', 'success');
});
